verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only pre-approval checks, such as comparing pay runs to catch discrepancies before final approval, and role-based permissions over pay runs. Nothing documents cancelling, reversing, or correcting a payroll after it has been submitted but before employees are paid. Those pre-approval review features are adjacent controls and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can cancel or correct a submitted payroll before employees are paid
